subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should ordinary assistant-stage timeouts get one same-model/profile retry before auth-profile rotation or model fallback?
rationale: The implementation appears bounded and covered, but it intentionally changes auth-provider and fallback timing for existing setups, which is a product/runtime policy decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept Bounded Timeout Retry
options.body: Merge this policy so transient ordinary timeouts do not immediately spend auth-profile rotation while non-timeout auth, billing, quota, and rate-limit failures keep the existing path.

options.title: Keep Immediate Timeout Failover
options.body: Ask for a revision that preserves first-time ordinary timeout rotation/fallback and handles transient timeout noise through a narrower condition.

options.title: Split Session Repair First
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the aborted-leaf transcript repair to land independently before deciding the broader timeout policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Timeout Retry
recommendation.body: Merge this policy so transient ordinary timeouts do not immediately spend auth-profile rotation while non-timeout auth, billing, quota, and rate-limit failures keep the existing path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest recent agent runtime/session history among the routing candidates and is best positioned to decide the compatibility-sensitive policy tradeoff.
